findings: Legends white and black use enlarged ABU plates. They retain a textured, tinted band between the near-zero outer black and colored frame. The six other materials use Fourth Edition plates with a separately recolored stock mask.
The optional blackBorderLift only lightens a fixed 3.5%-of-card-width outer ring. It cannot remove a lighter tinted ABU band and can leave a dark strip between the lifted ring and the printed face.
Frame HSB skips source pixels with maximum channel below 0.075. The current multiplicative HSB model also cannot lift exact zero. Inner ink has not been calibrated.

All eight diagnostic scan border samples have median RGB 38/38/38. The uniform flat margins suggest image processing; they are display-reference values, not a measurement of physical ink. Interior black must be sampled independently.

variants: Fourth source with its native black stock mask
same Fourth interior with an independently cropped Legends stock aperture
sourceReview.policy: All candidate renderings use the released painter and unchanged lettering with color calibration disabled. The previous shared Fourth proposal is replayed against current frozen scan poses; no scan is fitted to a renderer. The cropped candidate borrows the Revised construction method, not Revised border dimensions. Its stock aperture and RGB 38 are provisional visual controls. No new geometry/color defaults or accuracy claims.
sourceReview.decision: Fourth removes the unwanted ABU band and is the preferred source to fit next for Legends white/black. Refit the chosen Fourth interior and its stock boundary independently; compare native mask versus cropped stock before adoption. Existing ABU HSB coefficients must not transfer to the Fourth source.

greenSeam.cause: Fractional outer bounds of a white plate and recolored stock mask are antialiased separately. The second partially covered edge does not completely cover the first. This is not Safari-only.
greenSeam.fix: Paint outer stock before the unchanged mask, covering the plate edge without moving its inner aperture. The fix adds no asset edits, new calibration values or per-frame work.
greenSeam.validation: 72 synthetic cases across Chromium and WebKit; 42 native replays across seven Legends cards, both tiers, and bundled Chromium, installed Chrome and WebKit. All sampled outer strips become uniform RGB 8. Chrome/Chromium interior pixels are identical; WebKit independently prepared color materials differ by at most one byte.
greenSeam.deployment: Source branch only; not yet deployed.

blackCalibrationPlan: Choose the correct frame source and fit shared geometry first. Printed set controls border policy; using an ABU source must not implicitly assign ABU border behavior to another set.

Measure interior black strokes and stock separately on frozen aligned nonfoil references. Avoid antialiased boundaries, worn corners, rules/title ink and illustration. Use existing frame/art/rules geometry to locate small sampling strips, with erosion and pose-sensitivity checks.

Aggregate per-card measurements robustly into shared per-set black targets and report spread. Begin with a target shared across frame colors; split only when calibration evidence and validation support it. Do not fit per-scan color corrections.

Keep independent outer-stock and interior-ink targets for Alpha/Beta. For other sets, test whether one target explains both; do not force an outer scan margin's potentially processed RGB into the interior.

Add an opt-in black-point/shadow-curve term to frame material calibration. Use a bounded monotone curve, preserving midtones/highlights beyond a measured transition. Fit source black to reference black without clipping all shadows to a flat floor. Preserve alpha. This replaces the hard dark-pixel exemption only for opted-in frame materials; mana glyph protection remains independent.

Use the resolved stock target for both procedural stock and any stock mask. Preserve the public border-only override semantics. Apply frame curves during cached material preparation and include them in cache identity; no per-frame readbacks or hand-drawn masks for every source.

Validate border RGB error, interior black error, shadow chroma/contrast and structural edge scores separately. Check unchanged midtone/highlight pixels, antialiasing, banding and seams. Replay at table and inspect tiers, and through the deployed loader before release.
